tasks.title: Phase 1: Download Sefaria texts from official API
Phase 1: Prepare training data in JSONL format
Phase 1: Data audit and verification
tasks.build: echo "Checking file counts..." && find sefaria_texts -name '*.json' | wc -l > data_audit.txt && wc -l training_data.jsonl >> data_audit.txt && head -5 training_data.jsonl >> data_audit.txt

tasks.title: Phase 2: Document base model selection decision
tasks.build:
echo '# Base Model Selection

Decision: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct
Reason: Excellent multilingual support including Hebrew, strong reasoning, fits in RTX 5090 VRAM
Alternative: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (if Hebrew support insufficient)' > BASEMODEL_DECISION.md

tasks.title: Phase 3: Install training dependencies (Unsloth, TRL, PEFT)
tasks.build:
echo '# Training Dependencies

Required packages:
- unsloth[cu121-torch240]
- trl>=0.9
- peft>=0.8
- bitsandbytes>=0.43

Note: Install separately to avoid conflicts' > TRAINING_DEPS.md

tasks.title: Phase 3: Create unsloth_finetune.py training script
tasks.build:
echo '# Unsloth Fine-tuning Script

Tasks to implement:
- Load Qwen2.5-7B in 4-bit quantization
- Configure LoRA adapters (r=16, alpha=32, dropout=0.05)
- Set training hyperparameters (LR=2e-4, batch=4, epochs=3-5)
- Save checkpoints every 500 steps
- Merge adapters and export to GGUF' > unsloth_finetune.py

tasks.title: Phase 4: Run fine-tuning on Sefaria corpus
Phase 4 Complete: Model trained and saved
Phase 5: Create evaluation script and test suite
tasks.build:
echo '# Evaluation Script

Tests to implement:
- Torah passage continuation
- Talmudic argument structure
- Hebrew-English translation accuracy
- General Judaica knowledge Q&A' > evaluate_model.py

tasks.title: Phase 5: Run evaluation against base model
Phase 6: Export model to GGUF format for Ollama
tasks.build:
echo '# GGUF Conversion

Steps:
1. Merge LoRA adapters into base model
2. Convert to GGUF using llama.cpp
3. Quantize to Q4_K_M for efficient inference' > GGUF_EXPORT.md

tasks.title: Phase 6: Create Ollama Modelfile and load model
tasks.build:
echo 'FROM ./judaism-llm-qwen2.5-7b-gguf
PARAMETER temperature 0.7
PARAMETER top_p 0.9
TEMPLATE """
You are an expert in Jewish texts including Torah, Talmud, and commentaries. Provide accurate, well-sourced responses in Hebrew and English.

{{ .Prompt }}
"""' > Modelfile

tasks.title: Phase 6: Create CLI chat interface script
tasks.build:
echo '#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Simple chat interface for Judaism LLM"""

import sys

# TODO: Implement Ollama API integration
# - User input prompt
# - Send to Ollama API
# - Display response
# - Handle Hebrew text properly

def main():
    print("Judaism LLM Chat")
    print("Type your question in English or Hebrew:")
    print()
    
    while True:
        user_input = input("> ")
        if user_input.lower() in ["exit", "quit"]:
            break
        # TODO: Call Ollama API
        print("Response: [TODO - Implement API call]")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
' > chat.py && chmod +x chat.py
tasks.acceptance: test -f chat.py && test -x chat.py && grep -q 'Ollama' chat.py

tasks.title: Judaism LLM Project Complete
tasks.build:
echo '# Judaism LLM Project Complete

All phases finished:
- Phase 1: Data acquisition (10,000+ texts)
- Phase 2: Base model selected (Qwen2.5-7B)
- Phase 3: Training infrastructure ready
- Phase 4: Model fine-tuned
- Phase 5: Evaluation complete
- Phase 6: Deployed to Ollama

Model available via: ollama run judaism-llm
' > PROJECT_COMPLETE.md
tasks.acceptance: test -f PROJECT_COMPLETE.md && grep -q 'All phases finished' PROJECT_COMPLETE.md
